title: Missing market inputs
detail: No official, timestamped sportsbook quote was captured. NFL schedule pages are not a price archive. Own fair lines are shown separately; market edge and CLV remain blank.
action: Collect authorized operator feeds with pre-kickoff timestamps and retain the original response.

title: Missing player-prop market
detail: No current operator prop quote or participation snapshot was verified. Historical 2024 thresholds are research examples, not current betting lines.
action: Capture operator-specific props and official participation evidence before evaluation.

title: No economic validation
detail: No strategy has the pre-registered out-of-sample market history required by the gates. No profit, skill, or reward claim is made.
action: Run the locked protocol on future, untouched observations; never backfill a holdout with guesses.

title: Correlation scope
detail: The 2024 Burrow–Chase correlation is a 17-game, single-team historical estimate. It is not a current-season or universal SGP correlation.
action: Estimate on broader matched game logs with uncertainty and out-of-sample joint calibration.

title: Model assumptions
detail: Home advantage is disabled (zero assumption), not estimated. Injury, weather, roster and quarterback adjustments are unavailable and left blank. International venue is flagged.
action: Verify point-in-time inputs; estimate adjustments only in training folds.

title: Source title mismatch
detail: The URL says point spread, but the retrieved article explains moneylines. It is not used as a spread definition.
action: Review the official article; obtain a correct spread reference before adding one.

title: Dynamic-source discrepancy
detail: A search-index excerpt showed an older 2026 row than the rendered official page. Only the rendered 2024 row is used here; search snippets are not treated as live data.
action: Use frozen rendered evidence and re-read the official page on refresh.

title: Access limitation
detail: The public help page describes official game books, but the schedule endpoint redirected to a login/error page. No authenticated or bulk GSIS data was obtained.
action: Use publicly available NFL Game Center links or an authorized GSIS arrangement.

title: Slug irregularity
detail: The guessed jamarr-chase URL returned a player.DisplayName placeholder. The verified ja-marr-chase URL returned the actual named log and is the only player-log source used.
action: Keep canonical official URLs in the source register; never accept placeholder pages.

title: Sample selection
detail: The study deliberately selects one QB–receiver pair and one completed season. It is descriptive and susceptible to selection bias; it is not a league-wide edge discovery.
action: Pre-register a league-wide universe and evaluate untouched seasons.

title: Settlement variability
detail: FanDuel help is operator-specific. A universal void/reprice rule is not verified and must not be assumed across books.
action: Store the exact operator, jurisdiction, rule version and betslip terms with each quote.

title: Rule-version control
detail: The explicitly extracted overtime change is labeled 2025. The 2026 scoring PDF is separately verified; do not silently apply historical rules to later seasons.
action: Pin the effective rulebook version to each season and re-verify before model updates.

title: No live ingestion claim
detail: This release is a frozen 2026-11-02 research snapshot. The site does not claim live odds, live injuries, or automatic sportsbook execution.
action: Treat every refresh as a new evidence snapshot and rerun all gates.
